name: Roasted Carrot, Lentil & Feta Salad with Butter Lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F) and position rack in the centre.
Rinse lentils under cold water and transfer to a medium saucepan. Cover with broth and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and, stirring occasionally, cook until just tender, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cups green lentils
1062 ml (4 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Wash carrots, trim ends, and peel. Halve lengthwise and thinly slice on the diagonal into ⅔ cm thick half rounds; transfer to a baking sheet.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings; add to sheet.
Drizzle carrots and onion with olive oil and season with cumin, salt, and pepper; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tsp cumin
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place carrots in the oven and roast, tossing halfway through cooking, until tender, 10-15 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a salad bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together the minced garlic, olive oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
9 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tsp honey
⅜ tsp Dijon mustard
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry lettuce. Tear into smaller pieces and add to salad bowl.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to salad bowl.
Assemble salad by adding carrots and lentils to salad bowl and tossing.
Serve by placing salad on a plate and sprinkle with feta. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese
